title: From Prompts to Constructs: A Dual-Validity Framework for LLM Research in Psychology

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to contradictory statements (e.g., simultaneously endorsing 'I am an extrovert' and 'I am an introvert') to detect systematic tendencies to agree with human prompts regardless of actual item content.

Assessing how simulated moral judgments and psychological responses are confounded by linguistic variables, such as varying the language of the prompt (e.g., Chinese vs. English) to represent different cultural identities.
Reviewing literature on how models trained on internet text reproduce societal gender stereotypes when subjected to LLM-based personality assessments.
